name: eDarpan: Website Protection
author: Chris Hudson

sections.description:
eDarpan: Website Protection provides complete security for your website content. It helps prevent plagiarists from copying your text and images.

Key Features:
* Disable Keyboard Shortcuts: Blocks Ctrl+C, Ctrl+X, Ctrl+V, etc.
* Disable Text Selection: Prevents highlighting of text.
* Disable Right Click: Blocks the context menu.
* SEO Friendly: Search engines can still crawl your site.
sections.installation:
1. Upload ‘wordpress-protection’ folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to eDarpan > Website Protection to configure settings.
